test_title: All India SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025: Marks Booster Mega Live Test - 04
subject: general
question:
Choose the appropriate option that fills in the given sentence correctly:

That route is dangerous; ________, we have no guide.
solution:
The correct answer is **"besides".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Besides" is the correct choice.
 
• In this context, "besides" means in addition to or furthermore.
 
• It helps to convey that not only is the route dangerous, but also there is the additional issue of having no guide.
 
• This creates a logical and coherent connection between the two parts of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is "option 3".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Likewise" means in the same way or manner.
 
• "Consequently" means as a result or effect.
 
• "However" indicates a contrast or contradiction.
